title: Kusoma kwa Mapana (Theme 4: Saa na majira)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 5 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child keeps private details private, avoids unknown links and strangers, and uses the device for a short time in good light.
steps: Tell an adult; rest the eyes.

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child sorts eight cards into safe and unsafe.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ni hatua ipi ya kiusalama?" Kwa nini "Kumpa rafiki nenosiri langu" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Nenosiri ni siri yako. Usimpe mtu mwingine, hata rafiki, ila mzazi au mlezi.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ujumbe usiojulikana una kiungo cha zawadi. Ufanye nini?" Kwa nini "Nikifungue haraka" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Viungo kutoka kwa watu usiowajua vinaweza kuwa hatari. Mwonyeshe mtu mzima kabla ya kuvifungua.

listen_for: Tovuti inayotaka jina na nambari ya simu yangu
misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Unatafuta kifungu cha kusoma. Utumie tovuti ipi?" Kwa nini "Tovuti inayotaka jina na nambari ya simu yangu" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Tumia tovuti salama zilizopendekezwa na mwalimu au mzazi, na usitoe maelezo yako binafsi.
Tumia kifaa kwa muda mfupi, mahali penye mwanga, na upumzishe macho.

checks.question: Mtu usiyemjua anaomba picha yako. Ufanye nini?
Unapaswa kutumia kifaa kwa muda gani?

skills.key_step: The child opens the folder before the file and searches with two or three key words on a safe site.

floor.prerequisite: Switches a computer or tablet on and off safely.
floor.question: Ni kitufe kipi huwasha tarakilishi?

representations: a real box file with papers (folder and file)
two screenshots: a real page and a trap
steps: Search with key words on a safe site.
contexts: the school computer lab (saa na majira)

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child opens the folder and the file on a real device or in order on cards.

listen_for: bonyeza "Majira ya Mwaka" kwenye skrini ya mwanzo
misconceptions.ask: Faili hii iko ndani ya nini?
misconceptions.repair: Faili huhifadhiwa ndani ya folda; fungua folda kwanza, kisha faili.

listen_for: naomba unipe habari zote kuhusu saa na majira tafadhali
misconceptions.ask: Ni maneno gani muhimu katika swali hili?
misconceptions.repair: Andika maneno mawili au matatu muhimu tu, na uyaandike kwa tahajia sahihi.

misconceptions.ask: Je, ulishiriki shindano lolote? Kwa nini ushinde simu?
misconceptions.repair: Ujumbe wa zawadi usiotarajiwa ni mtego; usiubonyeze.

misconceptions.ask: Kwa nini tovuti ya hadithi ihitaji nambari ya simu?
misconceptions.repair: Usimpe mtu yeyote mtandaoni jina lako kamili, shule yako wala nambari ya simu.

misconceptions.ask: Unaweza kutafuta kabla ya kufungua kivinjari?
misconceptions.repair: Washa kifaa, fungua kivinjari, andika maneno muhimu, chagua tovuti salama, soma.

checks.question: Andika maneno muhimu ya kutafuta habari kuhusu saa na majira.
